{
  "candidate_rtl": "module decoder_8bit
 #(
    parameter N = 8
) (
    input [N-1:0] in,
    output reg [(1<<N)-1:0] out
);
    wire [3:0] dec0;
    wire [3:0] dec1;
    wire [3:0] dec2;
    wire [3:0] dec3;
    integer i;

    assign dec0[0] = ~in[1] & ~in[0];
    assign dec0[1] = ~in[1] &  in[0];
    assign dec0[2] =  in[1] & ~in[0];
    assign dec0[3] =  in[1] &  in[0];

    assign dec1[0] = ~in[3] & ~in[2];
    assign dec1[1] = ~in[3] &  in[2];
    assign dec1[2] =  in[3] & ~in[2];
    assign dec1[3] =  in[3] &  in[2];

    assign dec2[0] = ~in[5] & ~in[4];
    assign dec2[1] = ~in[5] &  in[4];
    assign dec2[2] =  in[5] & ~in[4];
    assign dec2[3] =  in[5] &  in[4];

    assign dec3[0] = ~in[7] & ~in[6];
    assign dec3[1] = ~in[7] &  in[6];
    assign dec3[2] =  in[7] & ~in[6];
    assign dec3[3] =  in[7] &  in[6];

    always @(*) begin
        out = '0;
        for (i = 0; i < (1 << N); i = i + 1)
            out[i] = dec3[(i >> 6) & 3] &
                     dec2[(i >> 4) & 3] &
                     dec1[(i >> 2) & 3] &
                     dec0[i & 3];
    end
endmodule",
  "bottleneck": "The baseline has a factored decoder path that maps to an input buffer, a two-input AND stage, a NAND4 stage, and a NOR4 stage. The candidate makes the four 2-bit predecode terms explicit and combines one term from each group with a single four-input AND, reducing the logical depth of the selected output path.",
  "rewrite": "Partition the 8-bit input into four independent 2-bit fields. Each field is decoded once into four mutually exclusive terms, and every output is the conjunction of the four selected predecode terms. This preserves the exact one-hot shift result while exposing shared predecode logic and a balanced shallow output cone.",
  "expected_timing_gain": "Expected improvement from approximately three post-buffer logic levels to two, subject to fanout-buffer insertion on the shared predecode nets. The likely maximum arrival is reduced, with the greatest benefit on outputs whose baseline path traverses the full NAND4/NOR4 chain.",
  "area_or_other_cost": "Uses 16 shared 2-input predecode terms and 256 four-input output conjunctions. The replicated output conjunctions can increase area and predecode-net fanout compared with aggressive factored decoding, but the structure is intended to remain within the stated area cap and has no sequential, storage, or latency cost.",
  "functional_boundaries": "For the assessed override N=8, all 256 binary input values produce exactly one asserted output bit at index equal to the unsigned value of in; every other output bit is zero. The output width and parameter declaration are preserved, and all output bits are assigned for every input combination without latches or undefined behavior."
}
